t: This is a memorial bust of John F. Kennedy, made in 1965 by the sculptor Jacques Lipchitz. It stands in the lobby of International Students House on Great Portland Street, and you can see it through the glass doors from outside. It was moved here in April 2019 from its original spot on the Marylebone Road, after it was vandalised in 2017. Kennedy was the thirty-fifth president of the United States, the youngest ever elected, and the first Roman Catholic to hold the office. Lipchitz was a Lithuanian-born Cubist sculptor.
